::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" collapse="true"}
## Keyboard shortcuts
- **→ / Space**: next step · **←**: back · **F**: full screen · **Esc / O**: slide overview
- **M**: menu (jump to any slide, change theme)
- **S**: speaker view with notes and timer (lecturer)
- **C**: draw on the slide · **B**: blackboard
- **E**: printable view; then print to PDF from your browser to save a copy
:::
